scope: cached correspondence topology and count feasibility only; no inference, geometry solving, scoring or replacement policy
case_scope: all 46 canonical Stage7A pairs; annotate the existing 7 benefits and 6 harms after partitioning
near_duplicate_rule: connected components of all image keypoints within Euclidean radius; exact XY duplicates also reported; conservative grouping, not proof of a shared 3D point
grouping: union B/C correspondence graph on grouped keypoints; all edges sharing a grouped endpoint stay in one component
partition: SHA256 of salt, canonical case id and sorted component edges; no retries or outcome-dependent reassignment
train_count_interpretation: conservative distinct-edge screen related to original 20-match backend floor; necessary count check only, not an E-inlier or solver success guarantee
validation_count_interpretation: report every level without choosing one as a validated acceptance threshold; no statistical power claim
spatial_interpretation: report occupied cells, concentration and train/validation cell overlap; endpoint grouping does not establish spatial block independence
source_balance_interpretation: report common/B-only/C-only raw and physical-edge strata and their equal-quota capacity; do not select correspondences or score poses
GT_use: existing evaluation decisions provide retrospective focus labels only; no reference/calibration or pose arrays read; labels never enter partitioning
